prompt: Black learns to share the red truck
title: Share the Red Truck
irony: Black keeps the red truck all to himself to keep all the fun, so nobody plays and the fun stops until he shares and the fun comes back.

beats.title: The street wakes
beats.summary: Morning sun lights the street where a shiny red truck sits by the curb.

beats.title: The setup
beats.summary: Black hugs the red truck and dares Navy and Jade to take it.

beats.title: The setup builds
beats.summary: Navy asks for a turn and Jade grabs the string, but Black pulls away.

beats.title: The hook
beats.summary: All kids chant round the red truck while Black holds it tight.

beats.title: The problem
beats.summary: Black yanks the truck past Purple and it tips over, spilling sand.

beats.title: The problem builds
beats.summary: Black sits alone with the stuck truck while Navy and Jade walk off.

beats.title: The hook again
beats.summary: The kids chant again round the silent red truck on the curb.

beats.title: The turn
beats.summary: Lilac watches Black alone and remembers hogging her bake day prize.

beats.title: The turn deepens
beats.summary: Lilac kneels down and offers Black her timer for fair short turns.

beats.title: The hook, grown
beats.summary: Black hands Navy the string first and the street fills with cheers.

beats.title: Settle down
beats.summary: Kids take turns pulling the red truck up and down the sunny street.
